page_title: ROM 2-0 LAZ | AS Roma v Lazio 05/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+5' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+5' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
90+3' The resulting free kick from Angelino (AS Roma) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.

90+2' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Luca Pairetto stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. There is a free kick near the sideline to AS Roma.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
90' An attempted cross from Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) is cleared. It will be a corner kick for Lazio.
89' Here is a change. Nuno Tavares is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
89' The manager makes a subsitution with Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) coming on for Mattia Zaccagni.
88' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mile Svilar, who smothers the ball.
86' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
86' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

86' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lazio.
83' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
83' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
82' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
79' Substitution. Adam Marusic makes way for Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
79' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Boulaye Dia. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
78' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Leandro Paredes (AS Roma).
77' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle and it's Nuno Tavares (Lazio) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
76' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
76' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
74' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Paulo Dybala and he is replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
74' Substitution. Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) replaces Artem Dovbyk.
72' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) displayed very unsporting behaviour. Boulaye Dia (Lazio) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
72' The resulting corner from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
71' Unsporting behaviour by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma). Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.

71' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Corner kick. Lazio will have an opportunity.
69' A snap shot by Taty Castellanos (Lazio) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Mile Svilar produces a good save to thwart him.
68' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
67' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) replacing Alexis Saelemaekers.
67' Substitution. Lorenzo Pellegrini walks off the pitch and Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) comes on as a substitute.
65' The corner from Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is intercepted by Ivan Provedel.
64' A cross from Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, AS Roma are going to take it.

63' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
63' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) strikes a volley towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
59' Loum Tchaouna (Lazio) wasted a clear opportunity. He fired a first-time shot from point-blank range, but it rattled the crossbar!
58' Ivan Provedel pulls off a great save to deny Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
57' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
54' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Pairetto had an easy-decision to make.
53' A lofted cross from Adam Marusic (Lazio) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

50' A neat pass finds Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the bottom right corner, but Mile Svilar denies him with a good save.
50' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

50' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed under the crossbar, but Mile Svilar was alert and made an astonishing save! Lazio force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
48' The referee signals a corner kick to Lazio.
47' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the right side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper. Lazio win a corner.
46' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) serves up a nice cross, but Mile Svilar punches the ball away.
46' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Gustav Isaksen will be replaced by Loum Tchaouna (Lazio).
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) comes off for Boulaye Dia.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The ball is cleared after Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
44' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
42' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) attempts to find Angelino, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
41' It's like he was asking for a caution. Taty Castellanos (Lazio) receives a yellow card.
38' What an opportunity! Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) wins the ball from the resulting set piece and unleashes a precise shot from inside the goal area which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) was quite harsh and Luca Pairetto didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) for a foul that he committed a little earlier. Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) will miss the next game.
34' Total attempts – 6:5. 4:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
32' The referee is firm and issues Mario Gila (Lazio) a deserved yellow card. Mario Gila (Lazio) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
28' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
27' One of the AS Roma players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Lazio are awarded a free kick.
26' A clumsy foul by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle.
23' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the corner but it's cleared.
22' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Lazio will take a corner kick.
18' 2 - 0 Goal! Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 2:0.
18' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
17' A snap shot by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Mile Svilar produces a good save to thwart him.
15' The corner from Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is intercepted by the defence.

14' Mats Hummels (AS Roma) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle. Taty Castellanos (Lazio) commits a foul after dangerous play.

10' 1 - 0 Goal! Alexis Saelemaekers plays a long ball to Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the top right corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 1:0.
9' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) but poses no threat.
9' AS Roma seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

5' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Adam Marusic (Lazio) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
4' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.

3' Well-positioned Manu Kone (AS Roma) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the left post, but Ivan Provedel reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop! AS Roma have a corner.
3' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.

AS Roma will kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Luca Pairetto will officiate today.
